title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Bow-Wow Wonder Bark Park

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shibao, over here!

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Pant... Pant... Pant... Woof!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good boy. You got the ball, huh? Good boy!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You did good too, Sam...oh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I don't need a hug!
You can just give me the ball!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Watching Shibao and Samo play sure is soothing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, they're so cute. I've taken so many photos already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look how much Hona is smiling, too! She looks like she's having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's such a shiny, happy smile☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad we invited her out here.
I know, since we're here, why don't we get some playing in too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shibao! Come here, boy!

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Go play with Ichika, Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not over here! Go say hi to Ichika! She's over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He's running in circles around Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess we know who his favorite human is.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I need to try harder to get him to warm up to me...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aaah, I'm all full! That was really tasty!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was. Even Samo and Shibao's food looked tasty, honestly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The menu for dogs was really elaborate. They even had quiches and pancakes and everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They ate with such good manners, too. I was impressed.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now that we've had lunch, what should we do next?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's so much, it's hard to pick just one... Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! It says they take photos for you here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I saw that online.
They have a professional photographer who will take photos for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, like a commemorative photo?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! Since it's your birthday, why don't you go get one taken?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That sounds great! It's sure to be a nice keepsake!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Maybe I will, since we're here...
Ah, but in that case, I'd want a photo with everyone, to remember the day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh! Like a group photo from a school trip♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That would be fun!
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line: Hello there. Would you like a photo with your furry friend?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, yes! Would it be possible for all of us to be in the photo together?

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
Of course, that's fine.
Right over here, please.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You should be in the middle, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's have Samo and Shibao next to each other!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! So Minori can go right next to Honami!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then I'll stand here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I should be okay right here?

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
Are you all ready?
Here we go! Three, two, one...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What a super-duper wonderhoy picture!
Everyone's smiling sooo bright!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm so happy. This is such a wonderful memory already.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm so glad! It's a great memory for us too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice of them to print us each out a copy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I know! Since it's a commemoration and all, why don't we sign Hona's photo?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sign?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know, write birthday messages!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that would be so wonderful! I think I might cry every time I see the photo...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it would mean that much to you, that's all the more reason to do it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right. I'll do my best to write something that will make you smile!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Writing is fine and all, but shouldn't we actually say it first?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we haven't said it properly yet, huh.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I don't think we have!
Okay, let's all say it together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
In that case... Ahem!
Okay, ladies! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The day really went by in a flash.
Samo and I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looked like you and Shibao had a great time, too. I'm happy I got to play with him.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It sounds like everyone had lots of fun. I wish I could have come to play with Shibao, too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why don't we all go on a walk together sometime soon?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You mean, go on a walk with Shibao and Samo?
That's a great idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I would love that. I'll be sure to give you my birthday wishes in person then, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, thank you for the souvenirs from Wonder Bark Park.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The dog-shaped cookies and chocolate, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I went to wish her a happy birthday, but I ended up getting gifts back...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Stop being so self-conscious about that. She liked the cake you got her, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if you feel like you didn't do enough to celebrate, you can always do more.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd like to wish Honami a happy birthday too, so let's put something together soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I would appreciate the help.
Do you want to join in, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Honami.
Bow-Wow Wonder Bark Park was so much fun! I'm glad we got to spend the day together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, happy birthday. Glad to hear you had a good one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Keep up the good work with your band! We're all rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ladies and gentlemen! The time has come to wish Honami a happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthdaaaaaay!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthdaaay!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: From what Emu told us, you spent your birthday surrounded by friends and beloved furry companions! Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you haven't received our well-wishes yet!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I just finished programming new tricks into Robo-Dog. I'm sure you'll enjoy them, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh! Good job, Rui! I want to see Robo-Dog's new show too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, you heard them. We can't wait to celebrate with you, so look forward to our special show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday again!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That trip was so much fun. It was a really nice birthday, if I say so myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We got to play with Shibao, hang out and chat, eat a really yummy food... It was so refreshing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Refreshing and relaxing. The perfect birthday for Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! It was a warm and gentle day, just like Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You said you got to rest up, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things will be getting busier for us for sure, so we'll need you to take the helm, Leader.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! Let's keep making things more and more exciting for Leo/need, under Hona's leadership!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
We're all behind you, Honami. Thanks for everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and the others made it such a fun birthday for me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shibao had a great time, too. Even after we played so much, when we got home he was still zooming everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the photo everyone wrote their messages on made me so happy... I couldn't help but keep looking at it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all, for celebrating my birthday. I hope we can go out like that again, so I can make more memories to share with you.
